items.what_text: Implications for Zennify Engagement Timing: SO-01 (GoBanking 2025 upgrade) creates the most immediate technology decision window. Procurement conversations for adjacent platforms — CRM, marketing automation, data analytics — are most receptive during an active core platform upgrade cycle. SO-03 (RPA/AI strategy) signals C-suite buy-in for technology investment. SO-06 and SO-07 (WMG record + C&I milestone) confirm the business cases for Salesforce FSC Wealth and Commercial modules respectively. In Zennify's assessment Data Stewardship Program scores 1.0 out of 5, versus a typical 1.5 at comparable institutions [E-107].
items.why_text: The assessment found: “'Robotic Process Automation and Artificial Intelligence' listed as named core corporate strategy (investor presentations, annual letter)” [E-103]. At 1.0 out of 5, Data Stewardship Program sits 0.5 points below the 1.5 typically seen at comparable institutions — an early-stage capability with the widest distance to close. Closing that distance would strengthen the data and technology foundation the rest of the business is built on, so progress here compounds across the rest of the business.
